authorization.scope: 125 frozen public CAROL recommendation-detail records, inspected ephemerally for recommendation-response-classification-closure topology and aggregate-only capacity
authorization.basis: NTSB-authored reports, recommendations, and public docket material are public domain unless otherwise noted; recipient-authored material and third-party content are not assumed public domain

research_question: Can official NTSB CAROL records support a source-authentic recommendation-to-response-to-status-change-to-closure task with exact 32K, 64K, and 128K contexts after exact paragraph deduplication and conservative contact-text exclusion?
constraints: only records with a closed current status, a recipient response, a later NTSB-authored correspondence, and an explicit current-status phrase in that later NTSB text count toward executable lifecycle capacity
recipient-authored response text is excluded from the conservative capacity claim and cannot enter candidates without separate rights clearance
email, phone, and explicit personal-title paragraphs are excluded before conservative capacity measurement
exact paragraph deduplication precedes token counting; repeated templates, unrelated records, padding, and cloned text do not count
record identifiers and aggregate source hashes may be persisted, but response summaries, addressee names, correspondence identifiers, and contact strings may not

capacity is preflight evidence only; no candidate generation before a deterministic privacy transform, name/entity rescan, third-party quotation audit, historical-snapshot freeze, and unchanged near-duplicate, exact-band, derived-view, truncation, source-lineage, shortcut, and remove-one gates
